data.case_title: Burglary insurance claim – stolen items list requested
data.title: Request for stolen items list – burglary claim
data.summary: Musterländische Versicherung VVaG acknowledges Ruben Beispielgaard's burglary claim (Schadennummer HR-26-0714 882, Vertrag MV 55 120 447) from 11 July 2026 and asks him to send a complete list of the stolen items with purchase year and price plus the purchase receipts, by the deadline shown.
data.explanation: Your insurer needs a full list of everything stolen during the burglary, including when you bought each item and what it cost, plus your purchase receipts, before they can process your claim. Send this by the deadline shown (counted in working days, Monday to Saturday, excluding public holidays, from the date of this letter). You should also give the same list to the police so the items can be included in their search. The letter does not say what happens if you miss the deadline, but delaying may slow down your claim settlement.

key_facts.quote: Senden Sie uns die Stehlgutliste und die Kaufbelege bitte spätestens 10 Werktage nach dem Datum dieses Briefes; Werktage sind dabei Montag bis Samstag ohne die gesetzlichen Feiertage.

items.title: Send stolen items list and purchase receipts to the insurer
